scope: Read-only DOM/layout audit of new waveform sections in five viewport configurations. Supplements separate raw/live byte readback.

limitations: Firecrawl returned no usable session IDs or DOM measurements; direct Chromium live navigation failed CA validation. This is local browser rendering of freshly fetched verified-TLS live bytes, not a successful Firecrawl or direct-browser network session.
No screenshots were taken or visually inspected in this audit. Geometry, image state, text and links were inspected through DOM measurements.
The audit covers the new waveform section at the five specified viewport configurations; page-wide legacy layout and other projects were not exhaustively reviewed.
Link targets were read from the DOM, not navigated or submitted. Independent gated readback verifies publication bytes separately.
Read-only same-origin GET routing blocked other origins and all non-GET requests; this can affect unrelated external resources, which are separately recorded.

A bounded baseline comparison subsequently confirmed identical mobile scroll widths in all three pinned pre-checkpoint HTML blobs. The observed 17px/20px page-wide overflow therefore predates the new waveform sections; it was not changed in this task.

observations.text_snippet:
Conditional first-variation shell waveform: For the same specified narrow aligned quadrupole (delta = 1/1000, ell = 10^-10 in model coordinates), a continuous 4098-cell enclosure resolves the physical scalar’s linear first variation. The normalized trace H differs from its explicit comparator by less than 1.0000004 × 10^-7 on 0 ≤ x ≤ 3; the negative physical gain reverses its sign. The leading proper-time response coefficient now satisfies 6.06 × 10^15 < C < 7.44 × 10^15 in R_epsilon = epsilon^2 C + o(epsilon^2).

The retained background, exact-data, gauge, regularity and nonlinear support hypotheses remain explicit. The post-pulse estimate |H| < 4.752 × 10^-14 on 2 ≤ x ≤ 3 is a small-tail bound. No finite-amplitude nonlinear waveform, observed time scale or higher-dimensional Big Bang origin is established. Next: a wider state with a val

observations.text_snippet:
Forma de onda condicional de la primera variación de la capa: Para el mismo cuadrupolo alineado estrecho especificado (delta = 1/1000, ell = 10^-10 en las coordenadas del modelo), una envolvente continua de 4098 celdas resuelve la primera variación lineal del escalar físico. La traza normalizada H difiere de su comparador explícito en menos de 1.0000004 × 10^-7 para 0 ≤ x ≤ 3; la ganancia física negativa invierte su signo. El coeficiente principal de respuesta en tiempo propio ahora satisface 6.06 × 10^15 < C < 7.44 × 10^15 en R_epsilon = epsilon^2 C + o(epsilon^2).

Se conservan las hipótesis explícitas sobre el fondo, los datos exactos, el gauge, la regularidad y el soporte no lineal. La estimación posterior al pulso |H| < 4.752 × 10^-14 para 2 ≤ x ≤ 3 acota una cola pequeña. No se establece una forma de onda no lineal de amplitud finit
